_comment: Personal spawns: each player gets their own chests, collectables and monsters, anchored to real places. Each monster entry is a species: `wants`/`minds` are the kinds of effort (ROAD, GROUND, CLIMB, RUNE, WORD) it is weak to and shrugs at, `rune` is the rune whose road form it wants cut, `elders` name it at tiers 2 and 3, and `page` is its codex entry. docs/WORLD.md has the rules for writing them.

variants._comment: One creature in five of tiers 1 and 2 is a variant (world_objects/variants.py). The name stays plain and the client puts the variant in front: Stubborn Fen Troll.

kinds.name: Skittish
kinds.text: 30% less health and 20% fewer coins. It leaves after a day.

kinds.name: Mossy
kinds.text: Twice as likely to leave an item behind.

grudges._comment: A creature that leaves weakened, where one of its kind already left weakened, comes back once to the same place (world_objects/service.py expire_stale).
grudges.line: It got away twice. Now it's back, and grumpier.

monsters.name: Bog Wraith
monsters.flavour: A cold patch of air that follows the bank.
monsters.hint: Keeps to water and the paths beside it.

elders.name: Lock Wraith
elders.flavour: Colder, and it has learned to wait where people slow down.

elders.name: the Long Cold
elders.flavour: A whole bank's worth of cold. People put a second jumper on and blame the weather.

monsters.page: A cold patch of air that follows the bank. It keeps up with whoever is passing and falls behind only when they stop. Nobody has seen it, and several people have worn a second jumper because of it.

monsters.name: Fen Troll
monsters.flavour: Sleeps by the water; wakes for footsteps.
monsters.hint: Keeps to water.

elders.name: Culvert Troll
elders.flavour: Larger, and lives lower. It hears you a long way off.

elders.name: Old Arch
elders.flavour: Has held the water's edge so long it is mostly stone. It still wakes for footsteps.

monsters.page: Sleeps by the water; wakes for footsteps. It sits low and dislikes anyone who keeps going past it. A rune cut round it, a square of all things, annoys it most.

monsters.name: Tide Serpent
monsters.flavour: Only ever seen at the water's edge.
monsters.hint: Keeps to the water's edge.

elders.name: Ebb Serpent
elders.flavour: Comes in further than it should and goes out slower.

elders.name: the Spring Tide
elders.flavour: Takes the whole bank on its good days. It has a lot of good days.

monsters.page: Only ever seen at the water's edge. It comes in with the tide and takes the bank for its own until shown otherwise. A loop drawn along the shore is a line it will not cross.

monsters.name: Mire Hag
monsters.flavour: Has been waiting by the water a very long time.
monsters.hint: Keeps to still water.

elders.name: Mill-Pond Hag
elders.flavour: Has been waiting longer, and is less patient about it.

elders.name: the One Who Waited
elders.flavour: Nobody knows for whom. She has stopped saying.

monsters.page: Has been waiting by the water a very long time. She will not say for whom, and may have forgotten. She goes when somebody finally makes a note of her.

monsters.name: Rook Lord
monsters.flavour: Holds the green by the sheer number of rooks.
monsters.hint: Keeps to parks and gardens.

elders.name: Rook Baron
elders.flavour: More rooks. A firmer agreement.

elders.name: the Parliament
elders.flavour: Every tree, and a quorum.

monsters.page: Holds the green by the sheer number of rooks. There is no lord as such; there are the rooks, and an agreement. They lose interest in ground somebody else plainly knows better, or has written down.

monsters.name: Grey Stag
monsters.flavour: Stands in the mist and dares you.
monsters.hint: Keeps to high places.

elders.name: Grey Hart
elders.flavour: One contour higher, and it knows it.

elders.name: the Grey Royal
elders.flavour: Stands on the highest ground in sight and expects it noticed.

monsters.page: Stands in the mist and dares you. It is always one contour higher than you are. Come up level, or cut a triangle round it, and it finds it has somewhere else to be.

monsters.name: Moss Golem
monsters.flavour: Mostly wall. The moss is the dangerous part.
monsters.hint: Keeps to old walls.

elders.name: Lichen Golem
elders.flavour: Older wall. The lichen does the talking.

elders.name: the Garden Wall
elders.flavour: It has moved a stride a year for a long time. It is nearly at the path.

monsters.page: Mostly wall. The moss is the dangerous part. It moves about a stride a year, always towards the path, and stops for anyone who writes down where it has got to.

monsters.name: Hollow Sentry
monsters.flavour: Armour with nobody in it, still on watch.
monsters.hint: Keeps to walls with a view.

elders.name: Hollow Serjeant
elders.flavour: Armour that has started giving orders to nobody.

elders.name: the Empty Captain
elders.flavour: Holds a post nobody remembers giving it. It would like that written down.

monsters.page: Armour with nobody in it, still on watch. It was given a post and never given leave. Write down that the watch is over and it will take your word for it.

monsters.name: Ash Warden
monsters.flavour: Guards a fire that went out long ago. Nobody has told it.
monsters.hint: Keeps to old stones.

elders.name: Ember Warden
elders.flavour: Warmer than it should be. Nobody has told it either.

elders.name: the Last Watchman
elders.flavour: Has kept the same watch so long the watch is all that is left.

monsters.page: Guards a fire that went out long ago. Nobody has told it, and it would not thank them. It stands down for anyone who writes what is there now.

monsters.name: Gutter Drake
monsters.flavour: Small, quick, and fond of bins.
monsters.hint: Keeps to cafés, pubs and bins.

elders.name: Skip Drake
elders.flavour: Bigger, and it has found the skips.

elders.name: the Drake of the Back Lane
elders.flavour: Owns the bins of a whole lane. It has no idea what any of it is worth.

monsters.page: Small, quick, and fond of bins. It hoards anything that shines and has no idea what any of it is worth. Draw a loop round it and it assumes it has been caught.

monsters.name: Lamp Sprite
monsters.flavour: Flickers when you look straight at it.
monsters.hint: Keeps to lit windows and odd sculptures.

elders.name: Lantern Sprite
elders.flavour: Brighter. Harder to look at for long.

elders.name: the Last Lamp
elders.flavour: Lives in the one light that never quite comes on. It would like to keep it that way.

monsters.page: Flickers when you look straight at it. It lives in the one light that never quite comes on. It follows a triangle drawn on the ground the way a moth follows anything.

monsters.name: Cinder Hound
monsters.flavour: Faster than it looks. It tires of anyone who simply keeps going.
monsters.hint: Keeps to trails.

elders.name: Clinker Hound
elders.flavour: Runs hotter and longer than the small ones.

elders.name: Old Smoke
elders.flavour: You will not outrun it. It is not asking you to.

monsters.page: Faster than it looks, and it looks fast. You will not outrun it and it is not asking you to. It tires of anyone who simply keeps going, or stops to write it down.

monsters.name: Hedge Dragon
monsters.flavour: A small green dragon that naps in hedges and guards the flower beds.
monsters.hint: Keeps to parks and gardens.

elders.name: Thicket Dragon
elders.flavour: Bigger, and it has claimed the whole shrubbery.

elders.name: the Old Green Dragon
elders.flavour: The oldest dragon in the gardens. The gardeners leave it the sunniest bench.

monsters.page: A small green dragon that naps in hedges and guards the flower beds. It is about the size of a cat and twice as proud. New paths through its garden tire it, and a loop ridden round it sends it off.

monsters.name: Hill Wyvern
monsters.flavour: A lean wyvern that rides the wind above high places.
monsters.hint: Keeps to viewpoints and hilltops.

elders.name: Crag Wyvern
elders.flavour: Larger, with a nest on the steepest rock it could find.

elders.name: the Wyvern of the Heights
elders.flavour: It has watched every hill in sight for a very long time, and knows who climbed them.

monsters.page: A lean wyvern that rides the wind above high places. It likes a climber who comes all the way up, and a note left at the top. Anyone who only rides past below is beneath its notice.

monsters.name: Culvert Imp
monsters.flavour: A small, busy imp that lives where the stream goes under the road.
monsters.hint: Keeps to streams and water.

elders.name: Sluice Imp
elders.flavour: Bigger, and it has learned to work the little gates.

elders.name: the Imp King of the Drains
elders.flavour: It wears a bottle cap for a crown and rules every drain in town.

monsters.page: A small, busy imp that lives where the stream goes under the road. It collects lost spoons and keeps them in neat rows. A good long ride past it wears it out, and a note left for it does the rest.

monsters.name: Bridge Ogre
monsters.flavour: A big, slow ogre who sits under a bridge and asks everyone for a toll.
monsters.hint: Keeps to rivers, canals and bridges.

elders.name: Toll Ogre
elders.flavour: Larger, with a tin cup for the tolls it never gets.

elders.name: the Ogre of the Old Bridge
elders.flavour: So old it is nearly part of the bridge. It still asks for a toll, out of habit.

monsters.page: A big, slow ogre who sits under a bridge and asks everyone for a toll. Nobody has ever paid it. Ride a square round its bridge and it grumbles off to find another.

monsters.name: Stile Boggart
monsters.flavour: A shy little boggart that sits on stiles and swaps the gates around.
monsters.hint: Keeps to footpaths and the countryside.

elders.name: Gate Boggart
elders.flavour: Bolder, and it oils the hinges so the gates swing shut behind you.

elders.name: the Boggart of Every Stile
elders.flavour: It knows every stile for miles and has sat on all of them.

monsters.page: A shy little boggart that sits on stiles and swaps the gates around. Walkers blame the wind. It gives way to anyone exploring new paths, or to a note that says hello.

monsters.name: Milestone Goblin
monsters.flavour: A goblin with a notebook who counts every mile and argues about the numbers.
monsters.hint: Keeps to trails and cycle routes.

elders.name: Mile Goblin
elders.flavour: Older, with a bigger notebook and stronger opinions.

elders.name: the Goblin Who Counts
elders.flavour: It has counted every mile for miles around twice, and still disagrees with itself.

monsters.page: A goblin with a notebook who counts every mile and argues about the numbers. It respects distance more than anything. A triangle ridden near it muddles its sums completely.

monsters.name: Gatehouse Gargoyle
monsters.flavour: A stone gargoyle that guards old gates and only moves when nobody is looking.
monsters.hint: Keeps to castles, ruins and old buildings.

elders.name: Tower Gargoyle
elders.flavour: Larger, and it guards a whole tower instead of one gate.

elders.name: the Great Gargoyle
elders.flavour: The biggest of them all, with wings that could shade a market square.

monsters.page: A stone gargoyle that guards old gates and only moves when nobody is looking. It is very fond of stories. Write it a note, or ride a square round its gate, and it settles back into stone.

monsters.name: Bramble Wolf
monsters.flavour: A grey wolf with brambles in its coat that trots along the edge of the woods.
monsters.hint: Keeps to woods and wild places.

elders.name: Thorn Wolf
elders.flavour: Bigger, with a thicker coat of thorns and a fondness for blackberries.

elders.name: the Bramble King
elders.flavour: So covered in brambles that it looks like a walking hedge. Birds nest in it.

monsters.page: A grey wolf with brambles in its coat that trots along the edge of the woods. It is more curious than fierce. New paths through its woods wear it out, and so does a note left by a tree.

monsters.name: Rooftop Griffin
monsters.flavour: A golden griffin that perches on rooftops and statues to watch the town.
monsters.hint: Keeps to towers, artworks and landmarks.

elders.name: Spire Griffin
elders.flavour: Larger, and it only lands on the highest spires.

elders.name: the Griffin of the Rooftops
elders.flavour: It has sat on every roof in town and has a favourite chimney.

monsters.page: A golden griffin that perches on rooftops and statues to watch the town. It likes to see something new. Explore the streets around it, or ride a triangle near its perch, and it flies off happy.

monsters.name: Marsh Wisp
monsters.flavour: A small floating light that bobs over ponds and wet ground.
monsters.hint: Keeps to ponds and wetlands.

elders.name: Fen Wisp
elders.flavour: Brighter, and it has gathered a few smaller lights around it.

elders.name: the Lantern of the Marsh
elders.flavour: A light so bright that the ducks use it to find their way home.

monsters.page: A small floating light that bobs over ponds and wet ground. It is friendly, but easily bored. Explore the paths around its pond, or leave it a note, and it drifts away content.

monsters.name: Stone Giant
monsters.flavour: A sleepy giant made of old stones that dozes along ancient walls.
monsters.hint: Keeps to ruins and old walls.
monsters.leaves: a pebble the size of a loaf

elders.name: Boulder Giant
elders.flavour: Bigger, and it sleeps even more deeply.

elders.name: the Giant Who Sleeps
elders.flavour: So big and so still that people have built a wall along its back.

monsters.page: A sleepy giant made of old stones that dozes along ancient walls. It wakes slowly and grumbles a lot. A long ride past it, or a note left on its wall, sends it back to sleep.

monsters.name: Tavern Brownie
monsters.flavour: A helpful little brownie that tidies café tables and eats the crumbs.
monsters.hint: Keeps to pubs, cafés and places to eat.

elders.name: Cellar Brownie
elders.flavour: Older, and in charge of the cellar and everything in it.

elders.name: the Brownie of the Best Table
elders.flavour: It always has the best table, and it always saves you a seat.

monsters.page: A helpful little brownie that tidies café tables and eats the crumbs. It loves a chat. Leave it a note, or ride a loop round its corner, and it waves you on.

_lairs: 0.8.0: a lair is seven tiles round a park (its tile and the six around it), offered at level `minLevel` 2 to 6 km from where the player usually starts, one at a time and one a fortnight. Visit `need` of them by `lifeDays` and its great chest opens: `coins` (outside the per-journey cap), a Rare item, a Rare sealed chest, and Ingwaz the first time.

combat._comment: Effort is damage (app/world_objects/fight.py, docs/ROADMAP.md Appendix C). Starting values, to be tuned by backend/scripts/replay_fights.py against real outings. Nothing here is a time or a speed.
